five_sentence_summary: Lean checks formal statements and proofs; it does not read the README or papers that explain them.
A mathematician reviews what selected formal results mean, how the public pages may describe them, and what remains open.

The reviewed result record is docs/claims.json, while docs/publication_contract.json separately inventories the papers and docs/publication_evidence.json separately retains historical checker evidence.
Generated views reorganise those records, and the release program plus GitHub workflow stop publication when a written relationship fails.
A passing release means the recorded comparisons succeeded; it does not mean software understood every public statement or proved that the list is complete.

historical_checker_example.plain_result: One false README edit passed because its public claim had not been recorded. After the claim was recorded, the intact text passed and the same false edit failed.
historical_checker_example.purpose: Illustrate the boundary of explicitly recorded checks; this is not an architecture component or reliability score.

remaining_open_propositions.statement: Prove that S = ∑ φ(n)/2ⁿ is irrational, with no bound on a possible rational denominator.
Prove that Π = ∑_{n≥1} p_n/2ⁿ is irrational; the exact tail-shift equivalence and prime-gap constraints do not supply the required cofinal escape.
Produce certified non-integrality witnesses at unbounded parameters. A sufficient one-parameter form is to produce them along the lcm diagonal.
Decide whether 1/2 lies in the Mersenne achievement set. Yes refutes universal #257; no closes only this route.

paper_anchor.title: membership of 1/21 in the Mersenne achievement set

remaining_open_propositions.statement: Decide the exact 1/21 branch: equivalently, exclude the fatal/cofinite/aligned branch, contradict its eventual permanent affine-supercapacity recurrence, prove cofinally bounded scaled greedy remainders, or force an unbounded sequence of closed canonical quotient rows. A positive membership result would refute universal #257; no such producer is proved.
Prove irrationality for every infinite support A, not only the named support families formalised here.

Determine irrationality of the running-LCM reciprocal sum for finite prime sets of size at least three. For {2,3,5}, the rationality-to-carry bridge is established and cofinal local-window escape remains open.

Independently review whether the 1958 curve-length wording matches the exact Formal Conjectures path-image-length statement, whose negation is now Lean-checked using ani's explicit degree-seven polynomial. The checked one-dimensional Hausdorff-measure bound settles that formal statement negatively; the reported small-parameter family is not formalised.

Determine whether F(t) = ∑_{n≥1} 1/(tⁿ − 1) is irrational for every rational t > 1. Irrationality of F((31/4)^r) for every positive integer r is a Lean-checked Zudilin specialization; the 3/2 approximant with remainder control and the universal assertion remain open.

Prove the Erdős #243 assertion: if 1 ≤ a₁ < a₂ < ··· has aₙ/aₙ₋₁² → 1 and rational reciprocal sum, then aₙ = aₙ₋₁² − aₙ₋₁ + 1 eventually; the checked barrier does not settle the mixed-sign unbounded regime.

paper_anchor.title: no reduced tail is an integer

remaining_open_propositions.statement: Prove that B·T_a ∉ ℤ for every B ≥ 1 coprime to 30 and every a ≥ 1.

paper_anchor.title: residue inequalities after every starting index

remaining_open_propositions.statement: Prove that for every B ≥ 1 coprime to 30 and every a₀ ≥ 1 there are ℓ ≥ a₀ and h ≥ 1 with lpr_{W(ℓ,h)}(−B·F(ℓ,h)) > K(B, ℓ+h), where K is the defined long-paper cap.

paper_anchor.title: an exact function representing the distinct-height sum

remaining_open_propositions.statement: Represent D_{2,3,5} faithfully by a specified two-dimensional Mahler-type value theorem with every hypothesis verified, give a conditional theorem under explicit logarithmic nondegeneracy, or prove no such representation exists.
Decide whether every nonterminal canonical orbit of the reduced-orbit problem has limsup_n (log M_n)/n > 0, equivalently 2^n ≤ M_n^K infinitely often for some K ≥ 1.

paper_anchor.title: Four estimates for the first-harmonic sum

remaining_open_propositions.statement: Decide whether, for each h ≥ 1, some s ≥ 1 and 0 < η < 1 give, for every X₀, admissible X and L meeting the displayed size conditions for which the four first-harmonic bounds hold.

paper_anchor.title: bounded returns of the scaled remainder

remaining_open_propositions.statement: Decide whether the scaled actual greedy remainder returns cofinally to one bounded interval: whether some B < ∞ has 2^N r_N ≤ B at arbitrarily large N.

paper_anchor.title: arithmetic tests for the greedy sequence

remaining_open_propositions.statement: Decide whether a bounded-memory 2-adic or discrepancy invariant of the actual support forces a closed return or forbids permanent supercapacity, or prove no such invariant exists.
Decide whether the final-skip signatures prove |E − a_M| ≥ gap_M, contradicting 0 < a_M − E < gap_M, for E = ∑_{n≥1}(2^n − 1)^{−1} and the last-skip approximant a_M.

research_frontier.promotion_boundary: This dated frontier is public research evidence only: its activated results retain their exact premises and falsifiers, do not enter the reviewed claim registry or Comparator, and do not close Erdős 1041.
research_frontier.reading_rule: Read FRONTIER.md for dated refutations and open gaps, then STRONGEST_RESULTS.json for source-pinned activation. Premises and falsifiers retain local hypotheses; research rows do not settle historical correspondence or become Comparator claims.

revision_and_identity.revision_embedding_boundary: A tracked file cannot contain its own Git commit id without self-reference. Content freshness is enforced by the owner hashes below; agents query the checkout revision at runtime.
